reuse.why: Fintegra reuses bank selection and account linking, shares Akahu's extracted downloader, and takeover shares unlinking's extracted local cleanup.

duplication.why: Eligibility rules, link lookup, local unlinking, and transaction downloading each have shared implementations rather than provider-specific copies.

placement.why: Link orchestration remains in accounts/app.ts, transport and import handling remain in accounts/sync.ts, and provider types follow the existing model structure.

scope.why: The changes support the requested linking rules and provider integration, apart from an unrelated schedule import reorder.

maintainability.why: The shared helpers keep the design straightforward, although every provider wrapper must remember to validate before creating its bank entry.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider handlers use the shared validation and linking functions, and both unlinking paths use clearBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The downloader and local unlink cleanup are extracted and reused by their original consumers rather than copied under new names.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and its takeover branch; the extracted downloader gains serverUrl and providerName, all representing required variation without bypassing consumers.
